commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Mean token_delta (ainglish minus english) of the construct's forms over 8 preregistered fresh pairs in the genre of original b106754d, floor across the original's three-encoding tiktoken roster; per-pair min/max declared as bounds. Fresh-input replication: no pair reuses the original's content.
admissibility_gates: all 8 pairs frozen in the minted manifest before any count
roster identical to the replicated original's (three encodings) and tokenizer provenance declared
comparison_identity declared; genre mirrors the original's glosses and renderings

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: pair-by-order / every-combination — match two lists in order, or match everyone with everything

manifest.method: Independent replication of b106754d: tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per pair; english = a fuller lossless gloss stating the assignment cardinality explicitly, ainglish = the same facts as a full clause with the trailing qualifier; FLOOR = worst tokenizer mean across the original's three-encoding roster; 8 wholly fresh pairs, 4 pair-by-order and 4 every-combination.

test_set.english: Mira audits ledger one and Tomas audits ledger two: two audits, each ledger to one auditor and no crossing.
test_set.ainglish: Mira and Tomas audit ledger one and ledger two, pair-by-order.

test_set.english: The morning shift covers the north gate and the evening shift covers the south gate, each shift to exactly one gate with no overlap.
test_set.ainglish: The morning and evening shifts cover the north gate and the south gate, pair-by-order.

test_set.english: Probe alpha targets host A and probe beta targets host B, in matching order and nothing crossed.
test_set.ainglish: Probe alpha and probe beta target host A and host B, pair-by-order.

test_set.english: Key one unlocks vault one and key two unlocks vault two: one key per vault, in order.
test_set.ainglish: Key one and key two unlock vault one and vault two, pair-by-order.

test_set.english: Mira and Tomas each audit both ledgers, so every auditor checks every ledger: four audits in total.
test_set.ainglish: Mira and Tomas audit ledger one and ledger two, every-combination.

test_set.english: Every probe is run against every host, so each of the two probes hits each of the three hosts: six runs.
test_set.ainglish: The probes and hosts are run, every-combination.

test_set.english: Each of the three linters is applied to each of the four packages, so all twelve combinations execute.
test_set.ainglish: The linters and packages are applied, every-combination.

test_set.english: Both translators check both manuals, so every translator reviews every manual: four reviews altogether.
test_set.ainglish: Both translators check manual one and manual two, every-combination.
